name: 19th Digital Economics Conference (TSE Digital Center)
organizer: TSE Digital Center, Toulouse School of Economics, with CEPR
venue: Toulouse School of Economics, 1 Esplanade de l'Universite, Auditoriums 3 (JJ Laffont) & 4
submission_requirements: Online form; one paper per participant, single file (16 MB limit) with title, authors and abstract; abstracts considered but papers more likely to be accepted. Economics (theory, econometrics, experimental, policy) plus other social sciences and computer/data science
registration_fee: EUR 150 academic / EUR 250 non-academic; waived for speakers, discussants, partners, TSE members and students
membership_required: No membership requirement stated in the last call
keynotes: Chiara Farronato (Harvard Business School); Joshua Gans (University of Toronto)
